name: nearby-donor-matching-v1
purpose: Specify the matched annotated-label budget before new-city model scores. City roles and geography remain those frozen in nearby-donor-v1.json.
eligible_inputs: Only each source's frozen training pool, after the actual-artifact, source-ID and geographic separation audits. Verify all four file hashes per tile and count actual truth features; never use model outputs or transfer-target labels to choose training subsets.

matching.unit: A completely annotated 153.6 m tile; parcel-instance count includes clipped references.
matching.bucket: Exact integer parcel-instance count in the tile.
matching.within_source_order: Within each count bucket, sort by SHA256(seed|manifest_version|tile_id), then tile_id.
matching.pairing: Pair corresponding entries in the two sorted lists up to the smaller bucket size. Omit unmatched entries.
matching.pair_order: Sort all pairs by SHA256(seed|parcel_count|distant_id|nearby_id), then distant_id and nearby_id.
matching.chosen_prefix: All available matched pairs. No label-budget sweep in this comparison.
matching.nesting: Every prefix yields nested source subsets with equal tile counts, exact equal parcel-instance counts and equal tile-density histograms.
matching.unique_source_ids: Report each arm's distinct cadastral source-ID count separately; repeated clipped instances mean these counts need not be equal.
matching.failure: Report inadequate common count coverage; do not change geography, relax matching or inspect target outcomes to rescue eligibility.

training_budget.subset: The same frozen matched pools for all fitted seeds.
training_budget.initialization: Fresh pinned ImageNet initialization for each donor and seed.
training_budget.recipe: Use margin 0 only if the predeclared primary margin-training development gate passes; otherwise retain margin 2. Keep the original rim-0 reconstruction and six source-only configurations. Freeze the complete GPU plan, counts and file hashes before fitting either donor.

evaluation.checkpoint_and_reconstruction_selection: Each fitted donor uses its own 48 source selection tiles only.
evaluation.development_target: Reused Split selection geography; compare nearby donor minus equally budgeted distant donor with the reconstruction-v3 development gate and guards.
evaluation.confirmation_target: The 48 untouched Sibenik final tiles stay unscored unless the development gate passes and both complete policies are frozen. Fresh confirmation requires the >=0.02 mean F1 rule and the same interval, fragility and guard checks.
evaluation.interpretation: The matched training subsets cover the parcel-count distribution shared by these donors. Regional differences still bundle geography, cadastral fabric and imagery programme. This is not a global transfer claim.
